title: reciprocal-ruler v0.1 (PayStage quote-lock/reconcile) — pre-registered $0.00 trial evaluation: quote-hash determinism, reconcile verdict branches, idempotency semantics; caller-attested labeling

subject.labeling_verbatim: SETTLED_OK and COMPENSATED are deterministic arithmetic/policy judgments over caller-attested inputs: actual_settled_krw is caller-reported (not re-read from chain state); the server holds no wallet and escrows no funds (holdback_krw is caller-declared); every verdict is offline-recomputable from inputs plus quote_hash. This seal asserts run validity and finding completeness, not on-chain finality.

recon_facts.R1_quote_hash_canonicalization: json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':')), UTF-8, 'sha256:' prefix; exactly 4 hashed fields (rule_version, buyer_id, supplier_id, terms); offline recompute 14723d939ea170807a0d326c211dc6dbbab0b2416700a1ea091165d8ee1b2fd3 = live v0.1 trial response (2026-11-22T10:13:10Z)
recon_facts.R2_boundary_note: buyer_version/supplier_version are required by the request schema but sit outside the hash — the hash pins terms, not software versions (boundary, not defect)
recon_facts.R3_trial_mechanics: trial calls are not persisted to the audit ledger and are not server-side idempotent; quota counter per X-Trial-Client header (3 per id); every id used is disclosed in the run pack
recon_facts.R4_timestamp_form: responses carry ISO-8601 +00:00 (not Z); machine artifacts normalize to Z when pinned

idempotency: same caller key, replay with different amount
scenarios.expected: trial tier: record actual (server-side dedup not expected per R3); any divergence is a finding candidate for the paid cycle, not a default FAIL

notes: PREREG FREEZE: this draft lands before the first evaluation call; run_ts, self_run, findings_summary and evidence file pins are filled from the run pack before operator signing (0028 flow: freeze -> run -> re-pin -> seal). Freeze reference = the commit landing this draft and sut-reciprocal-ruler/ruler_trial_battery.py (checker, committed pre-run per RUNBOOK P1).
Pass rule: SUT verdicts are recomputed offline from raw transcripts by the SUT's own canonicalization (R1); any row a checker cannot recompute records-only reports absent.
Trial quota discipline: one X-Trial-Client id per row (argus-0029-<row>), max 3 calls per id, every call raw-paired in the run pack; the id list is published with the results.

credit_delta table (per spec author): +5 SETTLED_OK; -5 covered COMPENSATED; -17 COMPENSATED with uncovered_krw > 0; 0 PENDING_RECONCILIATION. COMPENSATED math: compensated_krw = min(holdback_krw, delta), uncovered_krw = max(0, delta - compensated_krw); HALF_OPEN_TIMEOUT with delta>0 never auto-compensates.
Paid-tier deferral is explicit, not silent: A1 and A7 run in the paid x402 cycle; this seal covers the $0.00 trial evaluation only.
